UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated learner profile and 60-day course preferences

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user

emailVerified.description: Whether the user's email address is verified

banglaExplanations.description: Whether Bangla explanations are enabled for lessons

accountStatus.description: Current lifecycle status of the learner account

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp())

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp())

UserSession.title: UserSession
UserSession.description: Active or past device login session for multi-device management

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID owning this session

deviceName.description: Human-readable device model and OS label

authProvider.description: Authentication provider used for this session

activeSession.description: Whether the session is currently active

lastActiveAt.description: Server timestamp of last session activity (FieldValue.serverTimestamp())

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when session was recorded (FieldValue.serverTimestamp())

/users/{userId}.description: Private learner profile, verification sync, learning settings, and account status

/users/{userId}/sessions/{sessionId}.description: Per-user device session log supporting multi-device visibility and revocation
